task: Connect the script-tool-calls bridge to real platform tools (EPMCDME-15402): run-context propagation, authorizer, tool call via normal entry point, typed errors, confirmation tests, logging check, echo handler replacement, docs and rollout checks.

key_reasoning.reason: New abstractions (run context, authorizer, tool-call handler) threaded through AssistantService/ToolNode, ToolkitService/ToolsService, AgentWorkspaceService, ExecuteWorkspaceScriptTool/WorkspaceScriptRunner, BatchJobRunner/JobToolCallBridge and ToolCallChannel (closed error model, handler sees payload only).

Closest pattern is ToolsService.find_tool_from_config / ToolExecutionService by-name resolution, but it does not cover authorization scoping, a plain handler thread outside contextvars, or the never-log-payload requirement (CodeMieTool._run logs Arguments on failure; handle_tool_error turns failures into strings). Authorizer is security-sensitive with no exact precedent; workflow recognition signals are inconsistent (bare step sets only conversation_id) and the workflow project is not carried into get_tools. Acceptance criteria enumerate error/variant cases (blocked, unavailable, failing, no-context, three policies) with no existing test template for the script tool.

Roughly 8-10 modified production modules (tool_call_channel, job_bridge, batch_job_runner, execute_workspace_script_tool, agent_workspace_service, toolkit_service, toolkit_settings_service, assistant_service, tool_node/tool_service, README) plus a few new small modules and many new/updated tests across 3+ directories.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped to XL: affects authorization (authorizer by assistant/workflow/no-context scope) and security-sensitive handling of tool credentials and call content
Component Scope XL: affects multiple workflows/agents (assistant-mediated and bare workflow tool steps) and touches shared channel/toolkit contracts
